newsitem.title: USA: Chile buys 360,000 bbls of Oriente crude for April.
newsitem.headline: Chile buys 360,000 bbls of Oriente crude for April.

text.p: Chile's state-owned oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) bought a small cargo of Ecuadoran Oriente crude in its latest purchase tender, trade sources said.
ENAP paid a discount of $3.50-4.00 a barrel to May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing for the 360,000 barrel cargo, which will be delivered at the end of April.
Chile had originally tendered to buy 960,000 barrels of crude. Because ENAP only bought a small Oriente parcel, traders speculated that the company would announce another tender shortly.
Next time, Chile is likely to pick up West African crude, which has moved westward in large volumes as a result of turnarounds in Asia and weak demand in Europe, traders said.
